question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **"as".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **"As" **is used to compare two things that are similar in some way.
 
• It is often used to introduce a simile or metaphor.
 
• In this sentence, the blank is comparing "blank number 4" to the options listed before it.
 
 
• **Example:** She runs
